entries.title: Matthew 8:1
segments: When He had come down from the mountain, great crowds followed him.

entries.title: Matthew 8:2
segments: And behold, a leper came and worshiped him, saying, Lord, if You will, You can make me clean.

entries.title: Matthew 8:3
segments: And Jesus put [out] His hand and touched him, saying, I will; be clean! And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

entries.title: Matthew 8:4
segments: And Jesus said to him, See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the priest. And offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

entries.title: Matthew 8:5
segments: And when Jesus had entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, beseeching Him,

entries.title: Matthew 8:6
segments: and saying, Lord, my son lies at home paralyzed and grievously tormented.

entries.title: Matthew 8:7
segments: And Jesus says to him, I will come and heal him.

entries.title: Matthew 8:8
segments: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that You should come under my roof; but only speak the word, and my boy will be healed.

entries.title: Matthew 8:9
segments: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this one, Go! And he goes; and to another, Come! And he comes; and to my servant, Do this! And he does [it].

entries.title: Matthew 8:10
segments: When Jesus heard, He marvelled and said to those who followed, Truly I say to you, I have not found such [great] faith, no, not in Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 8:11
segments: And I say to you that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 8:12
segments: But the sons of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

entries.title: Matthew 8:13
segments: And Jesus said to the centurion, Go. And as you have believed, [so] let it be to you. And his boy was healed in that hour.

entries.title: Matthew 8:14
segments: And when Jesus had come into Peter's house, He saw his wife's mother laid out and in a fever.

entries.title: Matthew 8:15
segments: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her. And she arose and served them.

entries.title: Matthew 8:16
segments: And evening coming on, they brought to Him many who had been possessed with demons. And He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick

entries.title: Matthew 8:17
segments: so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying, "He took [on Himself] our weaknesses and bore [our] sicknesses."

entries.title: Matthew 8:18
segments: And seeing great crowds, Jesus gave orders to depart to the other side.

entries.title: Matthew 8:19
segments: And a certain scribe came and said to him, Master, I will follow You wherever You go.

entries.title: Matthew 8:20
segments: And Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air [have] nests, but the Son of man has nowhere to lay [His] head.

entries.title: Matthew 8:21
segments: And another of His disciples said to him, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

entries.title: Matthew 8:22
segments: But Jesus said to him, Follow Me, and let the dead bury their dead.

entries.title: Matthew 8:23
segments: And He entering into a boat, His disciples followed Him.

entries.title: Matthew 8:24
segments: And behold, a great tempest arose in the sea, so much so that the boat was covered with the waves. But He was asleep.

entries.title: Matthew 8:25
segments: And His disciples came to [Him] and awakened Him, saying, Lord, save us! We perish!

entries.title: Matthew 8:26
segments: And He said to them, Why are you afraid, little-faiths? Then He arose and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

entries.title: Matthew 8:27
segments: But the men marveled, saying, What kind [of man] is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

entries.title: Matthew 8:28
segments: And when He had come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, two demon-possessed ones met Him, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that no one might pass by that way.

entries.title: Matthew 8:29
segments: And behold, they cried out, saying, What [have] we to do with You, Jesus, Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before the time?

entries.title: Matthew 8:30
segments: And there was a good way off from them a herd of many swine, feeding.

entries.title: Matthew 8:31
segments: And the demons begged Him, saying, If You cast us out, allow us to go away into the herd of swine.

entries.title: Matthew 8:32
segments: And He said to them, Go! And when they had come out, they went into the herd of swine. And behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea and perished in the waters.

entries.title: Matthew 8:33
segments: And those who fed [them] fled. And going into the city, [they] told everything, and what had happened to the ones who had been possessed of demons.

entries.title: Matthew 8:34
segments: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged that He would depart out of their borders.
